jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Luminary

Luminary is an AI-native system of action for wealth transfer, connecting clients' assets with generational gifting and philanthropic goals.

$90 trillion will pass between generations in the decades ahead, yet more than 70% of high net worth clients report a large gap between the services they expect and what they receive.

Luminary solves this by transforming complex estate planning documents into a structured, proprietary data asset that powers agent-driven workflows for tax and wealth transfer services.

Our customers are leaders across the private client ecosystem — top wealth managers, national tax advisory practices, and law firms among the AM Law 100. Our proprietary data and workflow positions us to rapidly expand from wealth transfer advice into large, adjacent markets including trust administration and estate distribution.

Luminary was founded in 2022 and is backed by leading venture capital investors, prominent wealth management firms, and several family offices.



The Opportunity

As a Customer Success Manager at Luminary, you play a key role in engaging & expanding our customer base, as we continue to rapidly scale.

You will partner with our customers to transform their business with Luminary, creating loyal champions, managing the end-to-end customer lifecycle, from onboarding & engagement through renewals, upsells, and advocacy.

Candidates must be excited by working across multiple layers at customer firms - executives, operations and end users - to drive platform engagement and success. This role offers significant exposure to leadership and rapid growth for ambitious, low-ego individuals.



What you'll do

 - Manage and grow a book of business, owning renewals and expansion

 - Onboard new customers with mutual success plans and clear milestones to achieve customer goals and successful rollouts

 - Develop deep platform and trust & estate knowledge to drive customer engagement through training and ongoing support

 - Partner closely with product and engineering to shape roadmap initiatives with customer insights



Qualities we're excited to see:

 - 5-8 years of experience, with at least 3 as a CSM in B2B SaaS and ideally experience in wealth management or wealth tech

 - Familiarity with wealth management or experience working with RIAs, family offices, or trust and estate attorneys — deeply curious about building domain knowledge

 - Strong project management skills that connect tactical work to strategic outcomes

 - The ability to dig into data to find trends and insights that can be translated into customer success

 - High agency, proactive, and action-oriented

 - REAL — Resilient, Empathetic, Accountable, and Low-Ego



Why you’ll love working here

 - Represent a leading-edge vertical AI application defining a new product category that will transform an industry

 - Work alongside our CEO and co-founders — industry and tech leaders with decades of experience

 - Join a GTM team that collaborates on strategy, commercial assets, and execution

 - Thrive in a fast-paced environment where we're constantly shipping based on customer learnings

 - Luminary is a one-of-a-kind opportunity for massive impact at profitable scale — and a ton of fun along the way.



Compensation

The salary range for this role is $130,000 to $165,000. This role is eligible for a performance-based bonus, commissions, and equity. Compensation is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.



Benefits we offer

We believe firmly that happy, healthy employees will do their best work.

 - 👩🏻‍⚕️ 100% employee health insurance coverage (plus 50% dependent coverage)

 - 🧘🏽‍♀️ Monthly wellness, commuter, and educational stipends

 - 🏖️ 4 weeks PTO

 - 🛥️ 401(k) plan

 - 🍼 Parental leave policy

 - 🏢 NYC office where much of the team works 3+ days a week

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LUMINARY

Luminary is an AI-native system of action for wealth transfer services.

High net worth households controlling more than $90 trillion in assets are meaningfully underserved by technology that was built for the mass market. As private client investment and banking products have commoditized, these clients are looking for more tax and wealth transfer advice which has previously been impossible to deliver at scale.

Luminary solves this problem by transforming complex estate planning and ownership documents into a structured, proprietary data asset that powers verticalized, agent-driven workflows for tax and wealth transfer services. Our built-in multi-firm collaboration connects a client's full advisor ecosystem and is the core infrastructure that enables our customers to deliver a highly personalized, end-to-end wealth transfer service offering at scale.

Our 1,000+ customers are leaders across the private client services ecosystem — including wealth managers from exclusive multi-family offices through top private banks and trust companies, national tax advisory practices, and law firms among the AM Law 100. Our focus and proprietary data positions us to rapidly expand from a wedge in wealth transfer advice into large, adjacent TAMs including trust administration and estate distribution.

Founded and led by CEO David Barnard, former Head of Wealth Management at AllianceBernstein, Luminary is backed by 8VC, Fin Capital, Rockefeller Capital, Focus Financial Partners, and several family offices.



The opportunity

Luminary is building its marketing engine, and this role owns the digital core of it. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you'll stand up marketing measurement from the ground up in HubSpot, own our email program end to end, and run paid acquisition that reaches the audiences at the heart of wealth management — financial advisors, trust and estate attorneys, and family offices. It's a hands-on, high-ownership manager role, with close cross-functional relationships across the GTM, product, and CS orgs.



What you'll do

Build and manage marketing reporting and analytics

 - Architect marketing measurement in HubSpot: lifecycle and funnel definitions, campaign taxonomy, UTM governance, and data hygiene

 - Build the dashboards leadership runs on: pipeline sourced and influenced, CAC, and conversion rates by channel and campaign

 - Own attribution and closed-loop reporting with sales, plus a monthly reporting rhythm that powers data-backed decisions

Own email

 - Run our email program in HubSpot: calendar, segmentation, and lifecycle nurture programs across prospects and customers

 - Protect deliverability (domain authentication, list health, sunset policies) and improve performance through disciplined A/B testing

Run paid digital

 - Own Google Ads strategy and execution — Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen — with conversion tracking done right (GTM, GA4, offline conversion imports from HubSpot)

 - Scale LinkedIn Ads — matched audiences, lead gen forms, document ads — against our target firms and personas

 - Test new channels (Microsoft Ads, review marketplaces, advisor trade media, podcasts) with clear hypotheses, budgets, and scale-or-stop criteria

 - Manage the paid budget end to end, and partner with content and design on ads and landing pages that convert



Qualities we'd be excited to see in an applicant

 - 4+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or another considered-purchase category

 - Deep HubSpot Marketing Hub skills: you have experience building workflows, smart lists, custom reports, and attribution dashboards

 - You've built or rebuilt marketing reporting before — funnel definitions, campaign tracking, and closed-loop reporting tied to pipeline and revenue

 - In-platform Google Ads experience, including conversion tracking you've set up yourself

 - Experience running LinkedIn Ads for a B2B audience

 - Strong email craft — segmentation, automation, deliverability — and the ability to be hands-on with copywriting



Nice to have (not required)

 - SEO fundamentals and a working point of view on AI search (GEO/AEO) — how brands earn citations in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity, and how to measure AI visibility

 - Familiarity with wealth management, estate planning, or marketing to another regulated financial audience

 - HubSpot (Marketing Hub Software, Reporting, Email Marketing) or Google Ads certifications



Why you'll love working here

 - You will represent a leading edge vertical AI application that is defining a new product category and will transform an industry

 - You'll build Luminary's digital marketing foundation yourself — and see your impact in the pipeline every week

 - You'll have a rare opportunity to work alongside our CEO and co-founders, as part of a GTM team that works closely together on strategy, commercial assets, and execution

 - You'll be part of a small and nimble team where your work has measurable impact on the business' success



Benefits we offer

We believe that happy, healthy employees will do their best work.

 - 👩🏻‍⚕️ 100% employee health insurance coverage (plus 50% dependent coverage)

 - 🏖️ 4 weeks PTO

 - 🍼 12-week parental leave 

 - 🛥️ 401(k) plan

 - 🧘🏽‍♀️ Monthly wellness and commuter stipend

 - 📚 Annual learning & development stipend

 - 🏢 NYC office where much of the team works 3+ days a week



Compensation

 - Base salary range of $115k–$145k, plus meaningful equity. 

 - Actual compensation depends on a number of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
